text: Hi, I'm Beeswax. Walk up to something and stare at it. I'll do the rest.
Bee fact found! Would you like to learn more?
I'll take that as a yes.
Fine. The next one's better anyway.

label: native_flower
text: Your next adventure: the flower. Look down at it.

label: honey_jar
text: Now go to your next adventure: one big step to your left.

label: bug_spray
text: Next adventure: one more step to your left. Brace yourself.

label: bee_hotel
text: Last one for now: one big step to your left.

label: pebble_dish
text: Bonus round: one step to your left. Look for the water.

label: beehive
text: One more to your left. Headquarters.
You found them all. Bee Scout badge earned. Go tell a human.
Come closer. I don't bite. I can't, actually.
Lift your chin a little so I can see it.
